title: An unexpected monthly fee from the credit union
situation: You have had a chequing account with Pacific Shore Credit Union for eight years and have never paid a monthly fee. Last month you noticed a $16.95 monthly fee on your statement. You later found out that the credit union had moved you to a different account package, and the notice had been mailed to your old address, even though you had updated your contact details. You decide to email your branch manager.
instructions: Explain why you feel the credit union should take responsibility.
Ask for a specific solution and say what you will do if the problem is not resolved.
structure: Formal greeting (Dear Mr./Ms. + surname) + purpose: an unexpected charge
Instruction 1: what you saw, when, how much, and what you found out
Instruction 2: acknowledge the bank's right to change products (I understand… However…), then show the error was theirs
Instruction 3: an exact request (refund amount + account change) + a firm but polite consequence
modelResponse:
Dear Mr. Kowalski,

I am writing about an unexpected charge on my chequing account, which ends in 4471. When I reviewed my October statement, I noticed a monthly fee of $16.95, even though I have never paid a fee in the eight years I have banked with Pacific Shore. Looking back, I found the same charge in August and September. When I called member services, I learned that my account had been switched to a new "Everyday Plus" package.

I understand that financial institutions need to update their products. However, the notice about this change was mailed to my previous address, even though I updated my contact details at your branch over a year ago and have received e-statements ever since. Since I was never properly informed, I do not believe I should be held responsible for these charges.

I would therefore ask you to refund the three fees, totalling $50.85, and to move my account back to a no-fee option. I have always been satisfied with your service, but if this cannot be resolved, I will have to consider transferring my accounts, including my mortgage, to another institution.

Thank you for looking into this.

Sincerely,
Grace Adeyemi

usefulExpressions.expression: I am writing about an unexpected charge on my … account
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Mở đầu thư gửi ngân hàng, nêu thẳng vấn đề về khoản phí.
Cụm phân từ mở đầu câu, giúp nối ý mượt và tăng độ đa dạng ngữ pháp.
Công nhận quan điểm bên kia trước khi phản biện – kỹ năng quan trọng ở mức 9.

usefulExpressions.expression: I do not believe I should be held responsible for…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: 'be held responsible' = bị bắt chịu trách nhiệm; lập luận trang trọng.
Nêu con số chính xác (Canadian spelling: 'totalling'), làm yêu cầu rõ ràng.

usefulExpressions.expression: if this cannot be resolved, I will have to consider…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Nêu hệ quả một cách lịch sự nhưng cương quyết, không mang tính đe dọa.

commonMistakes: Đe dọa thô lỗ ('I will close my account today and tell everyone'). Hãy nói hệ quả nhẹ nhàng: 'I will have to consider…'.
Ý 3 thiếu yêu cầu cụ thể. Nêu rõ số tiền hoàn lại và loại tài khoản mong muốn.
Viết nhầm số tiền hoặc tính sai tổng. Kiểm tra lại các con số – sai số liệu làm giảm độ tin cậy của thư.
Sai giới từ: 'a fee in my account' → 'a fee on my account'; 'I updated my address since one year' → 'over a year ago'.

review.notes: Checked all 3 bullets (problem, why the credit union is responsible, specific refund + consequence), arithmetic (3 x $16.95 = $50.85), realistic fee, 198 words. No changes needed.
